notes: FIX: bracketed photos (-2/0/+2 sets) were merging one to two stops too dark and flat - merged sets now render as bright and natural as single frames; night scenes untouched. NEW: a real Windows installer - run RAWKeepers-Setup and you're done (Start-menu entry, uninstall from Settings > Apps, no more extracting a 450 MB zip or 'Failed to load Python DLL' when it was run from inside the zip window). NEW: cameras that detect faces (Nikon Z, Sony) - the culler now reads where the camera focused and whether it locked a face, so the frame the camera nailed is the keeper, and people photographed from behind at dusk are found for the sunset rule. FIX: a folder of JPGs only (a card shot JPG, a phone export) said 'No photos found' - it is now culled and edited. FIX: Product Photos works in the shipped app (it never did). FIX: Chinese folder or user names no longer lose camera focus data or break editing. FIX: the first screen no longer flashes 'Free version / Upgrade to Pro' - during the beta it shows every feature unlocked and your days left. Still unsigned: click More info > Run anyway once on the installer.
notes_mac: NEW: LUT color grading - apply any .cube look as the final grade on every exported photo, live in the eyepiece, with seven built-in film & cinema presets (Warm Film, Portrait Film, Vivid Slide, Classic B&W, Teal & Orange, Cinema Roll-off, Matte Fade). Improved: harsh-daylight photos get their shadows opened automatically, halo-free. Plus bug fixes: the camera UI now scales as one unit at any window size.
